style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 116 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, marimba, bongos and bright trumpet hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Stripes and splashes, here we go!
The tiger is the biggest cat we know!
Orange and stripy, one, two, three,
Splash in the water, sing with me!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
Orange coat and stripes so dark,
Padding softly through the park!
Bigger than the house cat, big as can be,
The biggest wild cat, look and see!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is big? Who is big?
The tiger cat is really big!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Stripes and splashes, here we go!
The tiger is the biggest cat we know!
Orange and stripy, one, two, three,
Splash in the water, sing with me!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
Most cats stay away from the rain,
But tigers jump in again and again!
Paddle, paddle, swim so well,
Splishy, splashy, tiger swell!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Paddle your paws! (Paddle, paddle!)
Make a splash! (Splash, splash, splash!)
Swish your tail! (Swish, swish, swish!)
Now shake off the water, quick as a flash!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
Look at the stripes, every one,
No two tigers have the same, what fun!
Little cubs stay close to Mama, you see,
Snuggled up as cozy as can be!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is big? Who is big?
The tiger cat is really big!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Stripes and splashes, here we go!
The tiger is the biggest cat we know!
We splashed and sang, one, two, three,
Stripes and splashes, sing with me!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Stripes and splashes! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Stripes and Splashes! Tiger Song for Kids with Milo
meta.description:
Stripes and splashes! Sing and splash with Milo the bluebird and the tiger, the biggest wild cat in the world: an orange coat with dark stripes, stripes that are all its own, a big cat that loves the water, and cubs that stay close to Mama.
A tiger song for kids. Roar, swim and splash along. Ages 2-6.

Facts from National Geographic Kids and Smithsonian's National Zoo (tiger pages).

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Every fact is checked against trusted sources and every script is reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
